title: Cloudesign - Senior Full Stack Engineer - Node.js/React.js
description:
**Job Description :**
Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js, React.js, Headless CMS).
  
  
**About The Role**
We are rebuilding our public-facing web platform on a modern, headless architecture. You will design and build the content layer (Strapi) and the React front end that consumes it. The work is performance-sensitive, security-conscious and subject to regulatory and compliance requirements. You will be a hands-on senior engineer who shapes technical decisions and mentors others.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and maintain scalable web applications using React.js (Next.js preferred) and Node.js.
* Architect and implement content models, APIs and workflows in Strapi headless CMS.
* Build custom Strapi plugins, controllers, services, lifecycle hooks, middleware and policies, and handle upgrades across major versions.
* Configure roles and permissions, i18n, media handling, and draft/publish and review workflows to meet editorial and compliance needs.
* Build REST and GraphQL APIs and integrate the CMS with internal services, third-party APIs and authentication systems (SSO/SAML/OAuth2).
* Optimize for performance, SEO and accessibility (Core Web Vitals, SSR/SSG/ISR, caching, CDN).
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and take part in code reviews and architecture discussions.
* Own deployments with the DevOps team : CI/CD, containerization, environment management and monitoring.
* Apply secure coding practices (OWASP Top 10, input validation, secrets management, dependency hygiene) and support security reviews and audits.
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and document technical designs and decisions.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 6 to 8 years of professional software development, including 4+ years of strong hands-on Node.js (Express, NestJS or Koa) and React.js.
* Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience with a headless CMS, preferably Strapi (v4/v5), covering content modeling, custom extensions and production deployment.
* Solid understanding of REST and GraphQL API design.
* Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), including schema design and query optimization.
* Experience with state management (Redux, Zustand or React Query) and modern React patterns (hooks, context, code splitting).
* Familiarity with Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and at least one cloud platform (AWS).
* Experience writing unit, integration and end-to-end tests (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress or Playwright).
* Good understanding of web security, authentication and authorization.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work with product, design, content and compliance stakeholders.

**Good To Have**

* Experience in BFSI, fintech or other regulated industries, including audit trails, maker-checker approval flows and data-privacy requirements.
* Experience migrating a legacy website or CMS to a headless architecture.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, Terraform or similar infrastructure tooling.
* Experience with search (Elasticsearch, Algolia), CDN and edge caching, and observability tools (Datadog, New Relic, Grafana).
* Familiarity with SSO integrations (Okta, Azure AD) and role-based access control at scale.
* Contributions to open-source projects, or authored Strapi plugins.
* Experience with Strapi Enterprise features (review workflows, audit logs, SSO).

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
The DevOps Platform Engineering team builds and runs the tooling, platforms and workflows that every engineering team at MSCI uses to deliver software. We operate as a software engineering team whose customers are other engineers — we build internal products, APIs, automation and integrations, and we run them as products with roadmaps, users and service commitments.
  
  
We own and maintain several Developer tools in MSCI's developer toolchain end to end. That covers the tools engineers work in every day, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube and Cursor, as well as the platforms we build and run ourselves such as our Backstage-based internal developer portal. Ownership here means we select, integrate, secure, operate and continuously improve these services, and we are accountable for their availability,and adoption across the firm.
  
  
Alongside the tools, we enable standardisation across the software development lifecycle. We define the golden paths, reusable CI/CD workflows, platform abstractions, engineering standards and governance models that product and engineering teams adopt so they can move quickly without re-solving the same problems.
  
  
As part of the MSCI Core DevOps Engineering team, you will help shape where software delivery and developer enablement go next across the organisation.
  
  
**What The Team Owns**

* Developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Docker, Cursor
* Internal developer platforms: Backstage-based developer portal and our in-house developer productivity platform
* CI/CD platforms, reusable pipelines and release automation
* SDLC standards, golden paths and governance models
* Self-service capabilities, internal APIs and integrations that remove manual toil from engineering teams
* Developer experience measurement, adoption and the services we provide to engineering teams across MSCI

Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Build and maintain reusable CI/CD frameworks, GitHub Actions workflows, templates, and platform abstractions that make the golden paths the fastest way to ship software at MSCI — simple enough to adopt quickly, flexible enough for diverse engineering use cases.
* Develop and support internal platform capabilities, APIs, automation services, and integrations across the developer toolchain, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Cursor, Backstage, and our in-house developer productivity platform.
* Run the developer tooling estate as a product: monitor health and usage, resolve issues, manage upgrades and configuration, and improve the reliability of services engineers depend on daily.
* Apply proactive problem solving to developer pain points — find friction in engineering workflows before it is escalated, trace issues to root cause, and deliver durable fixes rather than workarounds.
* Bring intellectual curiosity and a critical thinking mindset to platform decisions: evaluate new tools, patterns, and approaches on their merits, and make evidence-based recommendations that raise the quality of what we deliver to our developers.
* Contribute to SDLC standardization initiatives and engineering best practices, translating agreed standards into working automation, templates, and controls.
* Partner with Security, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Risk, and Application Engineering teams to embed governance, compliance, and operational controls directly into engineering workflows and platform capabilities.
* Treat engineering teams as customers: gather feedback, document and support what you build.

**Required**
Your skills and experience that will help you excel
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Hands on Programming experience in Go or Java.
* Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, or related software engineering roles.
* Software engineering mindset, with hands-on experience building automation, APIs, internal tooling, or reusable workflows that other engineers depend on.
* Solid working experience with SCM and CI/CD tooling such as GitHub (preferred), Azure DevOps, and/or GitLab, including repositories, pipelines, reusable workflows and templates, permissions, and integrations.
* Good understanding of the SDLC and software delivery workflows, including source control governance, branching strategies, release processes, and developer enablement practices.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs and webhooks.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Operational mindset, with experience supporting tooling or services that other teams rely on in production.
* Intellectual curiosity and critical thinking — willingness to dig into unfamiliar problems, question how things work today, and evidence a better way.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Exposure to an internal developer platform or portal (Backstage or equivalent).
* Experience building self-service engineering workflows or developer enablement tooling.
* Experience with platform observability, engineering metrics, or developer productivity initiatives.
* Exposure to GitOps frameworks.
* Experience in GitHub Enterprise Platform & Services
* Familiarity with frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript for platform UI and tooling development.
* Agentic SDLC experience and AI-native development.

**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.

* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
  
  
MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We are looking for an experienced
**Software Engineering / Product Technology leader**
who wants to be part of this journey from an early stage.

**What You Will Build**

You will play a key role in architecting and developing technology platforms across:

•
**N2N / Multi-Sided Digital Marketplaces**
connecting businesses, service providers, infrastructure and supply-chain capacity.

•
**E-Commerce & Marketplace Technology**
integrating marketplaces, D2C platforms, OMS, WMS, inventory, fulfilment, advertising, pricing and revenue optimisation.

•
**Warehousing & 3PL Technology**
for distributed warehouse networks, fulfilment operations, inventory visibility and supply-chain orchestration.

•
**AI-Native Products & Agents**
using Generative AI, LLMs, machine learning, intelligent automation and agentic workflows.

•
**Data & Decision Intelligence**
capable of converting large volumes of operational, commercial and marketplace data into actionable recommendations.

•
**APIs & Integrations**
connecting ERP, WMS, OMS, TMS, marketplaces, e-commerce platforms, logistics partners and enterprise systems.

The objective is not simply to digitise existing processes.

**We want to rethink them.**

**Who We Are Looking For**

You should ideally have:

•
**10–15+ years of software engineering / technology product development experience.**

• BE / BTech or equivalent engineering degree, preferably from a
**premier engineering institution**
.

• Strong hands-on experience architecting and building
**scalable technology products**
, preferably within technology startups or high-growth product companies.

• Proven experience with
**N2N / B2B / B2C marketplaces, e-commerce platforms or multi-sided digital ecosystems**
.

• Strong understanding of modern
**cloud-native architecture, APIs, microservices, databases and scalable distributed systems**
.

• Practical experience designing or building products using
**Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, machine learning or AI-driven automation**
.

• Ability to think simultaneously as a
**Product Architect, Software Engineer and Technology Innovator**
.

• Experience taking products from
**concept → architecture → MVP → production → scale**
.

Most importantly, you should still enjoy
**building**
.

We are not looking for someone whose role has become entirely managerial. We want a senior technologist who can define architecture, make critical engineering decisions, work with developers and remain close to the product and the code.

**Technology Stack & AI-Native Architecture**

We intend to build Goldfishh’s technology platform as a
**cloud-native, API-first, modular and AI-native architecture designed for an Agentic AI future**

. The preferred technology ecosystem will include
**Python and TypeScript/Node.js**

, modern web frameworks such as
**React/Next.js**

,
**PostgreSQL and NoSQL/vector databases**

, containerised microservices using
**Docker/Kubernetes**

, and scalable cloud infrastructure on
**AWS/Azure/GCP**

. The AI layer will leverage
**LLMs, multimodal models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, knowledge graphs, MCP, tool/function calling and multi-agent orchestration frameworks**

, with the flexibility to work across leading foundation models and open-source models rather than becoming dependent on a single AI provider. The architecture should enable autonomous AI Agents to securely interact with our
**futuristic N2N Marketplace, WMS, OMS, TMS, ERP, e-commerce, logistics and external partner systems through APIs and event-driven workflows**

. We are looking for an engineer who can help us make the right technology choices in discussion with the core team while designing an architecture capable of evolving towards
**AI Agents that can reason, plan, execute, collaborate and automate increasingly complex supply-chain and commerce workflows.**

**Why Goldfishh?**

Goldfishh is 6 year old Tech stratup building at the intersection of two enormous ecosystems:

**Physical Supply Chains × Digital Commerce.**
Our operating businesses across warehousing, 3PL, logistics and e-commerce give us something particularly valuable for technology innovation:
**Real customers. Real warehouses. Real inventory. Real transactions. Real operational problems to solve.**

Our ambition is to convert that operating experience into
**disruptive, scalable technology products for the supply-chain and commerce ecosystem.**

**Our founding team comprises BITS Pilani / IIT alumni, bringing deep domain expertise, entrepreneurial experience and strong technology-product DNA. We are now preparing for our first institutional VC fundraise to accelerate the next phase of growth.**
We deliberately stayed away from VC funding in our formative years—choosing to first build the business, prove the model, acquire customers and generate revenues. Now, we believe the time is right to scale with external capital.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to look back a few years from now and say:

**“I helped architect and build that from Day One.”**

**This role could be right for you if…**

You have spent years building technology products, but your next chapter is not about joining another large engineering organisation.

You want
**ownership, experimentation, speed and the opportunity to create something genuinely new.**

If that sounds interesting, we would like to talk.

**Experience:**
10–15+ years

**Domain:**
SaaS | Marketplaces | E-Commerce | Supply Chain | AI

**Education:**
BE / BTech or equivalent, preferably from a premier engineering institution

**Company:**
Goldfishh Supply Chain Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

www.goldfishh.com

title: Agentic Coding Lead - MRO 360
description:
**Agentic Coding Lead, MRO360**

**Verdantis |**
Mumbai | Full-time

**About the Company**

Verdantis builds MRO360, an AI-native platform that helps maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) teams in asset-heavy industries clean, enrich, reason over, and act on their spare parts, inventory, procurement, and reliability data.

**Role Summary**

Verdantis is hiring a hands-on engineering leader to run the MRO360 team. The role combines technical leadership — architecture, delivery, and mentorship — with real coding across backend, frontend, and AI workflows. A core focus is establishing disciplined, agentic development practices: using AI coding agents to accelerate delivery while enforcing rigorous human review, testing, and production accountability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Engineering Leadership & Delivery**

* Own architecture and technical direction across backend, frontend, AI workflows, and integrations
* Translate product requirements into technical designs and shipped software
* Partner with product, AI, QA, DevOps, and customer-facing teams; surface risks early

**Hands-On Coding**

* Write and review production code across the stack; build APIs, services, and UI features
* Debug complex issues and improve performance, reliability, and observability

**Agentic Coding & AI-Native Engineering**

* Use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar coding agents in real workflows
* Build internal agents for code review, test generation, documentation, and refactoring
* Set guardrails, prompts, and standards governing what agents may change vs. what requires human review
* Red-team AI-generated code for hallucinated logic, security gaps, and weak tests before merge

**AI Product Development**

* Collaborate with AI engineers on LLM features, RAG pipelines, and data enrichment workflows
* Balance AI capability against accuracy, cost, latency, and customer trust

**Team Leadership**

* Mentor engineers through design and code review; set standards for quality and delivery
* Support hiring and build a culture of ownership and disciplined AI tool use

**Candidate Requirements**

**Must-Have**

* 8–12+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years in a technical lead / staff role
* Strong coding ability in at least two of: Node.js, Python, Java, React
* Experience building SaaS, enterprise, or AI-enabled products
* Practical, real-world use of AI coding tools or agents — not just autocomplete
* Ability to design simple agentic systems (LLM APIs, tool calling, structured outputs)
* Solid grasp of backend APIs, databases, auth, CI/CD, and production debugging
* Strong communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Strong Advantage**

* Experience with LLM apps, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen)
* Experience building developer-productivity agents (file edits, test runs, PR summaries)
* Familiarity with MRO, EAM, ERP, or procurement systems (SAP, Oracle, Maximo, Ariba, Coupa)
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, and 0→1 or 1→10 product building

**Success in the First 90 Days**

* Understand the MRO360 product and architecture; take ownership of a module or technical area
* Stand up at least one working coding-agent workflow (e.g., PR review, test generation)
* Establish a review path so AI-written code is challenged by tests and senior judgment before production
* Ship production-quality features and identify weak spots in architecture and workflow

**Ideal Fit**

This role suits a builder-leader who still enjoys writing code, has used AI coding tools seriously in production settings, and can red-team AI-generated output rather than accept it at face value. It is not suited to a pure management profile, someone who treats agent output as a shortcut around review, or someone who cannot operate production systems without AI assistance.

description:

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
  
  
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
  
  
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
  
  
**Get to Know our Team:**
The Full Stack Engineering Department builds the Agoda web and app products. We have several teams in front-end focusing on different aspects of our products including accommodations, flights, payments, marketing, post-booking services, and more. Agoda’s marketplace is the world. We build localized and optimized user experiences at scale on every major internet platform. These include our mobile websites, native apps, and desktop sites. We hire people from around the world who have a passion for using technology to create and implement the best user experiences. Our teams work on the full stack and build end-to-end systems including user interfaces, APIs, backend systems, and database systems. Our products are always evolving and under experimentation. We accomplish this by having an amazing degree of automation, CI/CD systems, and use a modularized approach. As we are data driven and measure our results, we continually innovate and improve our work. We are looking for the next great talent who strives to learn and grow and has a standard of excellence, strong sense of ownership, and great technical skills.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
Staff Engineer is the key role in our technology organization working together with individual contributors and senior leadership. Our Lead engineers are heavily involved in the hiring and mentoring process and are the go-to people who design and implement new systems and components. We are looking for people who are passionate to take on more responsibility and driving major architectural changes in Agoda. It's expected from you in this role as Staff engineer to push Agoda forward technically by adopting new technologies and setting higher standards.

* Lead full-stack architecture and system design for features used by millions of customers across web and cross-platform environments.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.**
As part of Mondelēz International Digital Services, you have leadership responsibility for a specific discipline that may include partnering with leaders in sales, finance, marketing, customer service and logistics, procurement, HR etc. You are part of a team that delivers best-in-class service and value creation to their clients and that always strives for operational excellence.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
You will work with others to ensure that processes are understood and that changes are effectively implemented. To excel in this role, you will keep a close track on actions and issues and ensure they are resolved on a timely basis. In addition, you will be responsible for ensuring that services are provided and measured, including vendor management, contract management and service level agreements, offer suggestions to other stakeholders to enhance the experience strategy, ensure value delivery using performance metrics and analysis, and work with others to achieve operational excellence and continuous improvement to ensure customer-focused delivery of services.
  
  
**What You Will Bring**
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
  
  

* Working in a project-driven organization
* Managing multiple and diverse stakeholders
* Your specific discipline (in-depth)
* Change management and governance processes
* Influencing and communicating with others
* Presentation skills
* Compliance and controls (experience in audits or part of programs where compliance is important)
* Working effectively in a constantly changing environment and using initiative and personal resourcefulness

**Job Profile Summary**
As part of Mondelēz Digital Services, you will play a key techno-functional role within the Customer Care product team, shaping customer care capabilities across process, technology, data, and service operations.
  
  
Customer Care is focused on improving how we serve customers, reducing friction, and strengthening execution against customer and business priorities across the OTC chain, including exception management across order management, fulfilment, delivery, invoicing, query management, and cross-functional coordination.
  
  
You will translate customer care needs into scalable product capabilities, workflows, functional requirements, data requirements, and integration designs. This role requires strong hands-on SAP design experience to enable the customer care solution, including the underlying OTC processes, data structures, integrations, and system dependencies, even where the end solution is delivered through platforms beyond SAP.
  
  
It requires a combination of technical depth, techno-functional design capability, and strategic thinking to shape scalable product solutions and support large-scale transformation across process and technology in complex global environments.
  
  
This role is the bridge between strategic vision and hands-on delivery for Customer Care and OTC technology. The person in the seat will own the technology strategy and roadmap, lead vendor assessment and selection, drive global solution design, and keep a sharp eye on Total Cost of Ownership — all while being comfortable rolling up their sleeves to design solutions, not just direct them.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* 17+ years of experience across Customer Care / Customer Service / OTC in complex FMCG environments with over 5 years of experience in a role with strategic focus.
* Hands-on experience with AI-enabled service capabilities, including intelligent triage, summarisation, recommendations, automation, and agent assist, and the ability to translate these into product and workflow requirements.
* Strong experience across customer-facing and service-related OTC processes, including order management, fulfilment, delivery, invoicing, query management, exception handling, and cross-functional issue resolution.
* 15+ years of hands-on techno-functional solution design experience, translating business needs into product capabilities, workflows, functional specifications, data requirements, integration requirements, and scalable technology-enabled solutions.
* 19+ years of strong hands-on SAP design experience across OTC processes, including process flows, configuration implications, data structures, integration touchpoints, and end-to-end solution design support.
* Proven experience working closely with architecture, integration, product, and delivery teams to shape and implement fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Strong understanding of OTC-relevant master and transactional data, and ability to use this to support product design, visibility needs, workflow requirements, reporting, and process mining opportunities.
* Experience with process mining / operational analytics tools such as Celonis
* Proven experience in large-scale transformation across process and technology.
* Demonstrated ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, shaping scalable solutions aligned with longer-term product and service priorities

**Required Experience**

* Define and own the end-to-end technology strategy for Customer Care / Customer Service / OTC, aligned with the broader enterprise architecture and product roadmap.
* Develop and maintain a clear, compelling technology vision that connects business priorities to platform, product, and capability choices.
* Evaluate emerging technologies — including AI-enabled service capabilities (intelligent triage, summarisation, recommendations, automation, agent assist) — and translate them into actionable product and workflow requirements.
* Shape the evolution of the Customer Care product across OTC to improve service effectiveness, reduce friction, and strengthen execution.
* Define how the product should enable better customer interaction, workflow management, visibility, collaboration, and exception handling across the OTC chain.

**Vendor Assessment & Selection**

* Lead structured vendor assessment and selection processes for Customer Care platforms, tools, and enabling technologies.
* Develop evaluation frameworks (functional fit, scalability, integration, cost, risk) and run competitive benchmarking.
* Negotiate and shape vendor relationships in partnership with Procurement and Legal.
* Manage and challenge external Vendors and SI Partners to ensure fit-for-purpose delivery, strong design quality, and disciplined cost control aligned with Product and Program priorities.

**Global Solution Design**

* Support and drive the global design of new solutions across OTC processes: order management, fulfilment, delivery, invoicing, query management, exception handling, and cross-functional issue resolution.
* Translate business needs and operational pain points into scalable product capabilities, process requirements, data needs, and technology design inputs.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward-Deployed Engineer / AI Product Manager

Tuning Research · India (hybrid, at client sites)

About Tuning Research

Tuning Research is an applied AI engineering company, founded by IIT Kanpur alumni, that builds production-grade agentic AI systems for enterprises. We’re a 20-person team that works as an extended AI team for our clients across knowledge and documents, business operations, video intelligence, voice AI and marketing automation.

About the role

We’re hiring a Forward-Deployed AI Product Manager to own client transformations end to end: scope it, design it, build parts of it, ship it, and get it used.

You’ll be the one person from Tuning Research who lives inside the client’s business. Typically that’s a mid-to-large Indian enterprise replacing spreadsheets and legacy systems (HRMS, ERP, accounts, operations) with AI-native software. You sit with their teams, work out what should be built, design it, build and ship parts of it yourself, and make sure hundreds of people actually use it. A small remote team of AI, full-stack and mobile engineers works with you, and our founders stay closely involved.

The title says product manager, but the job is closer to a forward-deployed engineer: half product, half engineering, all of it on the customer’s ground.

What a week looks like

* Monday: At the client’s office. Stand-ups with business teams to agree priorities and blockers.
* Tuesday: Building. Backend endpoints, data migration scripts, an AI extraction flow, or a Figma screen.
* Wednesday: On the floor or at a site. Watch people use what shipped, demo it, capture what’s wrong.
* Thursday: Review the engineers’ code, test on real data, deploy, and fix what breaks.
* Friday: Write next week’s specs, then review with our founders and client leadership.

What you’ll do

*Scope the right thing*

* Run discovery across departments and map how work, material and money actually flow.
* Separate what people ask for from what they need. Decide what is configuration, what is a one-off, and what becomes a product feature.
* Turn findings into a prioritised monthly scope with clear acceptance criteria, and say no to things that would fragment the platform.

*Own the client relationship*

* Be the single point of contact for everyone from frontline supervisors to the MD.
* Run weekly working sessions, fortnightly reviews and monthly scope meetings, and keep one tracker of every request and decision.
* Explain trade-offs, delays and risks plainly, before they become surprises.

*Design the system*

* Own the system design: the data model, integrations with existing ERPs and accounting systems, and roles and permissions.
* Decide where AI belongs (document reading, matching, alerts, copilots) and where plain software is enough.

*Build, verify and deploy*

* Write backend code yourself: APIs, integrations, and data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* Review every pull request from your engineers, and test on the client’s real data before anything ships.
* Run releases and own incidents and fixes in production.
* Set up evals for AI features so accuracy is measured, not assumed.

*Design the experience and drive adoption*

* Design screens in Figma for people who don’t type much: offline-first, in Hindi and English, for low-cost Android phones.
* Test designs with real users before the team builds them. Train users and write simple guides.
* Watch usage, find where people drop off, and fix it.

What you need

* 3–6 years building and shipping software, including at least 2 years in a client-facing, founding-engineer, product-engineer or forward-deployed role.
* Strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript/Node: REST APIs, PostgreSQL or similar, and SQL you write yourself.
* Hands-on experience with LLM applications: prompt design, document extraction, retrieval, tool-calling agents, and evaluating output quality.
* Able to read, review and reject code. Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, Docker and one cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure).
* Product sense: you can write a clear spec, prioritise with explicit trade-offs, and design a usable screen in Figma.
* Able to run a workshop with a site supervisor in the morning and an MD in the afternoon, and you write plainly.
* Fluent Hindi and English.
* Willing to work from client offices and travel to sites, daily in the first month or two of an engagement.

Nice to have

* You’ve built ERP, HRMS, accounting or operations software, or you know Tally, GST, TDS or payroll.
* Experience with construction, infrastructure, manufacturing or field-operations businesses.
* You’ve shipped a mobile app (React Native or Flutter), ideally offline-first.
* You’ve led data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* You speak a regional Indian language beyond Hindi.

Who succeeds here

You have high agency and low ego, and you’re comfortable when the plan changes. You’ve shipped something real, whether at a startup, a hackathon or on an on-call rotation, and you’d rather fix the problem than write about it. You stay calm while a client watches you fix something live.

Work setup

* Location: Hybrid, at client offices in India. Daily for roughly the first 1–2 months of an engagement, then about 3 days a week.
* Travel: Regular visits to client sites.
* Team: You lead a remote AI engineer, full-stack engineer and mobile engineer.
* Reports to: Tuning Research founders.
* Engagements: Typically 12-month programmes, with the chance to roll out across the client’s group companies.

What success looks like

* 30 days: You’ve met every department and mapped how work and money move. The first monthly plan is agreed and the build is under way.
* 90 days: The first module is in use at pilot sites, the engineers ship every week, and the key build-vs-integrate decisions are made with the client.
* 6 months: Core modules are live and client leadership treats you as part of their team.
* 12 months: One platform runs the client’s core operations, and leadership sees the numbers daily.

How we hire

1. Intro call (30 min): Your background and why this role.
2. Discovery role-play (60 min): One of us plays a client’s department head describing a messy problem. You run the conversation and play back what you’d build.
3. Take-home (one weekend): Build a small API that uses an LLM to extract a real-world business document into structured fields. Add a one-page spec and one Figma screen for the end user.
4. Code and design review (60 min): Walk us through the take-home, and we review a pull request together.
5. Founders’ conversation: Working style, travel and expectations.

title: Senior Technology Solutions Specialist (OGC)
description:
**Description**
**About the Role**
The oil, gas and chemical sector is undergoing a profound and accelerating transformation. To maintain a competitive edge in an increasingly dynamic market, our organization is embracing digitalization and automation to enhance operational efficiency, improve safety standards, and drive long-term sustainability goals. This role is not merely about writing code or managing systems — it is about fundamentally reshaping how we operate. You will stand at the forefront of this transformation, harnessing cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges: from optimizing production workflows and predicting maintenance needs, to ensuring the security and resilience of our critical infrastructure.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated, innovative, and results-driven Senior Technology Solution Specialist to join our technology team. In this pivotal role, you will design, develop, and deploy software solutions that power our digital initiatives — playing a crucial part in building, implementing, and maintaining technologies that elevate our engineering processes to new heights.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Software Development & Solution Architecture
* Design, develop, and deploy scalable full-stack software applications supporting digital transformation initiatives across the oil, gas and chemical value chain.
* Lead end-to-end solution design from requirements gathering through architecture, development, testing, and production deployment.
* Build robust APIs, microservices, and data pipelines using Python and modern development frameworks.
* Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and frameworks to improve solution quality and delivery speed.
* Data Engineering & Analytics Platforms
* Develop and manage data solutions on Microsoft Databricks and Data verse, including data ingestion, transformation, modelling, and analytics workflows.
* Build and maintain data pipelines that enable real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance models, and production optimization dashboards.
* Ensure data quality, governance, and security across all digital platforms and data assets.
* Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to productionize machine learning models and analytical tools.
* Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
* Design, deploy, and manage cloud-based solutions on Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), following best practices for reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and DevOps practices to accelerate delivery.
* Monitor system health, performance, and security; proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure operational continuity.
* Manage infrastructure-as-code, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud-native architectures.
* Collaboration Platforms & Knowledge Management
* Design, configure, and manage Microsoft SharePoint solutions for document management, team collaboration, and internal portals.
* Develop automation workflows and integrations between SharePoint, Teams, and other enterprise systems to streamline operations.
* Champion digital workspace best practices and drive user adoption of collaboration tools across the organization.
* Agile Delivery & Project Management
* Act as Scrum Master for agile delivery teams, facilitating sprint ceremonies, managing backlogs, and removing impediments to ensure consistent delivery.
* Manage project workflows using Jira and Confluence — maintaining transparency, tracking progress, and providing stakeholder reporting.
* Mentor team members on agile methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and iterative delivery.
* Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders including engineers, operations, HSE, and business leaders to align technology solutions with organizational objectives.
* Innovation & Continuous Improvement
* Proactively identify opportunities to apply digital technologies — including IoT, AI/ML, automation, and advanced analytics — to enhance safety, efficiency, and sustainability.
* Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and technology pilots, translating business challenges into scalable digital solutions.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory requirements relevant to the oil, gas and chemical sector.

**Required Technical Skills**

* The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in Full Stack Development, Python, Microsoft Databricks & Data verse, Azure Deployment, GCP & DevOps, Microsoft SharePoint, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Jira & Confluence, and CI/CD Pipelines.
* Full Stack Development
* Proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Strong back-end development experience with RESTful APIs, Node.js, .NET, or similar server-side technologies.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB).
* Python
* Advanced Python programming skills for application development, data engineering, automation, and scripting.
* Experience with Python libraries for data processing and analytics (Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, SQLAlchemy).
* Microsoft Databricks & Data verse
* Hands-on experience building and managing Databricks workspaces, Delta Lake, and Spark-based data pipelines.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Data verse for data modelling, integration, and Power Platform solutions.
* Azure Deployment
* Proven ability to architect, deploy, and manage cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure (App Services, ADF, Azure Functions, AKS, Azure DevOps).
* Experience with Azure security, identity management (AAD), networking, and monitoring tools.
* GCP & DevOps
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform services (BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub).
* Strong DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and version control with Git.
* Microsoft SharePoint
* Experience designing and configuring SharePoint Online sites, libraries, lists, and workflows.
* Ability to develop custom SharePoint solutions and Power Automate integrations.
* Agile Project Management — Scrum Master
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM or equivalent) with practical experience leading agile ceremonies in cross-functional teams.
* Proficient in Jira for sprint management, backlog grooming, and reporting; Confluence for documentation and knowledge management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6 to 10 years of progressive experience in software development and IT, with demonstrated leadership on complex technology projects.
* Experience within the oil, gas, chemical, or broader energy and industrial sectors is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT convergence, industrial IoT, and digital twin concepts is a plus.
* Relevant certifications (Azure, GCP, Databricks, Scrum Master) are advantageous.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
* A self-starter with strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, and a passion for technology-driven innovation.

**What We Offer**

* A high-impact role at the center of the digital transformation of a critical global industry.
* Opportunity to work with advanced technology stacks across cloud, data, and automation domains.
* Collaborative and inclusive work culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.

**Why Join Us**

* This role places you at the intersection of engineering and technology on real projects that affect safety, schedules and long term assets. You will work with colleagues across India and the United States, see how design decisions turn into built facilities and shape tools that help people do some of the most complex work in our industry.
* Burns & McDonnell is an employee owned company, and many people build entire careers here because of the stability, long term horizon and shared ownership culture. The company is known for investing in its people through training, mentoring and opportunities to take on larger responsibilities over time.
* In this role you will have room to experiment with modern cloud tools, AI and automation, while staying grounded in the day to day needs of engineers and designers. For the right person, this is a chance to grow into a trusted partner for project leaders and a key voice in how digital work evolves in the OGC practice.

**Reporting Relationships**

* The Technology Solutions Specialist reports directly to the Technology and Innovation Manager. The role also maintains strong functional working relationships with the GP Manager, Engineering Manager, Department Managers and other Design Application Specialists. Day to day work planning will be coordinated with the Technology and Innovation Manager, with input from Engineering leadership on priority workflows and pilots.

**Future Roadmap**

* This role offers a unique opportunity to grow into a technology leader within our organization. In the first year, you will focus on mastering our existing systems and delivering key software projects. Following that, you will have the opportunity to lead new initiatives, mentor junior team members and specialize in areas such as artificial intelligence, cybersecurity or enterprise architecture. We are committed to your professional development and will provide you with the resources and support needed to stay at the forefront of technology and advance your career.

This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About DataNimbus:**

DataNimbus is an enterprise AI company with deep vertical solutions in financial services and industrial sectors. We build domain-native AI that understands how industries actually operate, not just how data flows through them. Our solutions are outcome-driven and industry-specific, delivering measurable results across how money moves, how assets perform, and how businesses grow. We go deep so our customers don't have to start from scratch.

***Domain depth. Enterprise scale. AI outcomes.***

**Why Join DataNimbus?**

At DataNimbus, we believe in shaping a sustainable, AI-driven future while offering an environment that prioritizes learning, innovation, and growth. Our core values—Customer-Centricity, Simplicity, Curiosity, Responsibility, and Adaptability—are the foundation of our workplace, ensuring every team member can make a meaningful impact. Joining DataNimbus means being part of a dynamic team where you can:

* Work with cutting-edge technologies and revolutionize workflows in Data+AI solutions.
* Contribute to solutions that are trusted by global businesses for their scalability, security, and efficiency.
* Grow personally and professionally in a culture that values curiosity and continuous learning.

If you're passionate about innovation, ready to solve complex challenges with simplicity, and eager to make a difference, DataNimbus is the place for you.

**Role summary**

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are the Field Innovation team for DataNimbus's Payments business. They spend their time on-site with customers in Mumbai and alongside our implementation teams. They understand the customer's view, find gaps in how FinHub is used, and close them - by building new solutions, fixing what blocks adoption, and helping Customer Success keep accounts healthy and growing.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**Be the customer's voice**

* Spend time with client users and implementation teams to understand how FinHub is used day to day, and where it falls short.
* Capture gaps in the product, the implementation and the client's own processes, and bring them back with evidence and a proposed fix.
* Help Customer Success read account health: adoption, friction points, risks and early warning signs.

**Strengthen implementations and customer success**

* Work alongside delivery owners and technical leads on live projects to unblock tricky integrations and edge cases.
* Step in on technical escalations with the implementation team, and turn the fix into something reusable.
* Support account reviews with insights, demos and improvement proposals.
* Spot expansion opportunities from what you see on the ground and shape them with the Customer Success and Sales teams.

**Discover**

* Work alongside client business, operations and IT teams to understand how money moves and where it breaks.
* Turn vague asks into clear problem statements, success criteria and a scoped pilot.

**Build**

* Build working prototypes on FinHub and around it: integrations with core banking, payment rails, host-to-host and API banking, escrow and virtual accounts.
* Write production-quality code (APIs, integrations, data pipelines, dashboards) that can be hardened.
* Use AI where it helps the client: reconciliation, exception handling, document processing, insights.

**Prove and hand over**

* Run pilots in the client's environment and measure results against the agreed success criteria.
* Present results and demos to client stakeholders up to CXO level, with Sales and Customer Success.
* Hand pilots to the Delivery/Competency team with clean code, documentation and a rollout plan.

**Make the product better**

* Turn what you build for one client into reusable accelerators and FinHub features.
* Bring client feedback and recurring gaps to Engineering and the product roadmap.

**Experience and skills**

**Must have**

* 5–10 years building software, with at least 2 years in client-facing/product engineering roles.
* Strong coding in at least one of Java, Go, Node.js / TypeScript or Python, plus SQL and a NoSQL store such as MongoDB.
* Built and integrated REST APIs, message queues and event-driven systems.
* Comfortable on cloud and container platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP; Docker, Kubernetes).
* Can explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical client stakeholders.
* Domain knowledge of banking / payments /transaction banking / liquidity / cash / escrow.
* Ability to travel and work on-site for 5-days during client engagements.

**Good to have**

* Indian payments domain: NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, escrow, virtual accounts, cash management or corporate API banking.
* Experience with core banking integrations (e.g. Finacle, Flexcube) or host-to-host file formats.
* Hands-on use of LLMs or ML in a working product.
* Awareness of RBI rules for payment aggregators, escrow and data localisation.

**Soft Skills**

* Bias to action: ships something useful in days, not months.
* Enjoys being on the client floor and is credible in the room.
* Owns outcomes end to end and is comfortable with ambiguity.
* Writes things down so others can pick up the work.

**Educational Qualification**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Interested?

Send in your CV to
careers@datanimbus.com

To build a scalable, multi-tenant SaaS application from the ground up, we need an experienced Full Stack Developer who can take complete ownership of features from start to finish. This is not a "code-only" role. You will work closely with stakeholders, drive key technical decisions, and help shape a secure, reliable, and scalable SaaS architecture that can grow with our customers.

9. Proactively identify risks, blockers, and technical debt, and propose practical solutions.
10. Set coding standards, lead code reviews, and mentor junior developers
11. Ensure application security, performance, uptime, and scalability as the user base grows

**What We Are Looking For**

**Must-Have Qualities**

1. **End-to-end ownership:**

title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
description:
Fospha is dedicated to building the world's most powerful measurement solution for online retail. For over a decade, we've helped teams make smarter decisions with full\-funnel marketing insights, forecasting, and optimisation. With Fospha, every team moves faster and grows smarter.

 **leading brands** 
 across three continents, including
 **Gymshark** 
 ,
 **Huel and Oh Polly,** 
 Fospha
 **manages $4 billion** 
 in annual ad spend.
   

  

 We're scaling fast across
 **London, Mumbai, and Austin** 
 – and we're now looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Team!
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll build the products our customers rely on every day to make multi\-million dollar media decisions. You'll work across the full stack \- from crafting responsive, intuitive frontend experiences through to designing and scaling the backend microservices that power them \- and, given the seniority of this role, you'll also help shape system design and infrastructure decisions as we scale.
   

  

 You'll work alongside engineers, product managers, and AI agents as part of our AI\-first operating model, where lean, high\-autonomy teams ship fast and learn faster. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who's comfortable owning a feature end\-to\-end \- from initial design through to production \- and who wants to grow their craft in a fast\-moving, ambitious environment.
   

  

 Where you'll focus
   

  

* Frontend development using modern JavaScript frameworks (React.js or Next.js)
* Backend development using Python\-based microservices
* System design and infrastructure, contributing to architectural decisions as we scale
* End\-to\-end feature ownership across the stack
* (Nice\-to\-have) Exposure to Data Science / Data Engineering workflows


**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and maintain full stack features \- from frontend UI/UX through to backend services and APIs in Python.
* Contribute to system design and infrastructure decisions, helping evolve our technical foundations as we scale.
* Get involved across the full Software Development Lifecycle, from initial planning and design through execution, release, and monitoring in production.
* Write clean, well\-tested, maintainable code, and champion good engineering practices across the team.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to translate requirements into working software.
* Build and consume APIs (REST/GraphQL) that connect frontend experiences to backend services.
* Work with AI agents as part of our AI\-first operating model, using clear specifications to shape high\- quality, AI\-assisted engineering work.
* Take ownership of the quality, performance, and reliability of the features you ship.
* Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving candid, constructive feedback.
* Stay curious about new tools and technologies, including opportunities to explore Data Science / Data Engineering problems as they arise.


**What are we looking for?**
* Have around 5\+ years of professional experience as a full stack / senior software engineer, with a balanced skill set across frontend, backend, and infrastructure.
* Have strong, hands\-on experience with front\-end technologies such as React.js or Next.js, and solid backend experience building and maintaining Python\-based microservices.
* Are comfortable contributing to system design and infrastructure decisions, reflecting the seniority of this role.
* Are comfortable working across the full stack and can move fluidly between frontend, backend, and infrastructure concerns.
* Have solid experience working in an agile environment and know how to embed quality into fast\-moving teams.
* Bring exceptional attention to detail and a genuine ownership mindset over what you build.
* Are enthusiastic about new technologies, with the ability to adapt and learn quickly \- we're open to candidates with strong experience in other modern languages/frameworks if the core skill set and seniority are a strong match.
* Have an awareness of spec\-driven AI development and how clear specifications shape the quality of AI\- assisted engineering work.
* Have the confidence and initiative to evolve ideas and pull pieces of work together into meaningful change.
* Have an active interest in self\-learning and growing your craft.
* Nice\-to\-have: exposure to Data Science / Data Engineering (not core to the role, but a strong plus).


 You don't have to tick every box. If you're a strong engineer who's hungry to step up, we'd still like to hear
   

  

 from you.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary
* Be part of a leading global venture builder, Blenheim Chalcot, and learn from the incredible talent in BC.
* Be exposed to the right mix of challenges and learning and development opportunities
* Flexible Benefits including Private Medical Subsidiaries, Life Assurance, Pension scheme etc
* 25 days of paid holiday \+ your birthday off!
* Quarterly team socials


**Our Values and Principles \-** 
 You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:
   

  

* Seek inclusion \& diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard
* Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact
* Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure
* Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems
* Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude


 Above all, our people show a willingness to work together and get their hands dirty to deliver product success, which means our customers are successful!

Our client\-centric approach focuses on driving long\-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub\-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
   

  

 We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long\-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
   

  

 Enterprise Risk \- helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
   

  

 Technology Risk \- helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
   

  

 Financial Services Risk \- helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

title: Security Researcher
description:
**About Job:** 




 We are looking for a security researcher with strong software engineering skills to help build an AI product for vulnerability discovery and validation. You will turn offensive security knowledge into agent capabilities, tools, and backend workflows that investigate customer and open source systems reliably.
 



  





**What you will build:** 



* Build backend components for agent execution, tool calling, model integration, and structured findings.
* Translate vulnerability research into agent workflows, reusable tools, and source code analysis capabilities.
* Implement controlled tool execution, sandbox isolation, scoped permissions, resource limits, and cleanup.
* Build persistent run state, retries, cancellation, crash recovery, and event streaming.
* Integrate security tools, independent verification, and evidence capture so findings are reproducible.
* Create realistic security scenarios, PoC\-based checks, and regression tests to improve detection quality and reduce false positives.



  





**Engineering experience:** 



* 3\+ years in software engineering, security engineering, or security research, with a track record of building software or security tools.
* Strong TypeScript/Node.js skills and Python experience for tooling, automation, and integrations.
* Experience with APIs, asynchronous systems, databases, automated testing, and debugging complex failures.
* Comfort with Linux, Docker, process/network behavior, and LLM tool calling; clear communication and ownership of components through delivery.



  





**Security knowledge** 



* Bring broad awareness across these layers, with hands\-on depth in at least two areas. Web/API or source code security should be one of your strongest areas.
* Web and APIs: injection, XSS, SSRF, IDOR/BOLA, authorization, tenant isolation, and business\-logic abuse.
* Source code and dependencies: insecure deserialization, memory safety fundamentals, vulnerable libraries, malicious packages, and CVE reproduction.
* AI and LLMs: prompt injection, jailbreaks, unsafe tool use, and MCP trust boundaries.
* Identity and infrastructure: network security, Active Directory, cloud IAM, federation, and privilege escalation.
* Runtime and systems: container, sandbox, and VM isolation; operating\-system permissions, service/library flaws, and kernel attack surfaces.
* Deep kernel research, exploit development, fuzzing, or agent\-framework experience is a plus.



  





**Show us what you have built** 




 Share backend or agent systems, security tools, or open source contributions you have built. Explain what you owned, the security reasoning, design choices, and reliability challenges. CVEs, bug bounties, and research write\-ups provide additional context. A high\-level description is welcome for confidential work.

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front\-end and back\-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy full\-stack web applications using modern front\-end and back\-end technologies.
* Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Develop robust server\-side applications, APIs, and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Design and optimize relational and non\-relational databases to ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity.
* Integrate applications with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and event\-driven architectures.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge\-sharing across teams.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 6–10 years of hands\-on experience in full\-stack application development.
* Strong proficiency in front\-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js and Microsoft 365 technologies like PowerApps.
* Experience in back\-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event\-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test\-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Forward Deployment Architect
description:
**About the Role:** 




 As a Forward Deployment Architect, you will serve as a hands\-on senior technical architect on the Applied AI Engineering team, owning the end\-to\-end design and delivery of AI\-driven business transformation projects.
 



  





 You'll work closely with pre\-sales teams to scope technical integration and implementation strategies, translating business requirements into architectural solutions. Once opportunities move to post\-sales, you'll own the detailed technical designs from original scoping documents and drive execution including hands\-on coding to build proofs\-of\-concept, custom integrations, and solution prototypes that validate technical feasibility.
 



  





 As the technical owner of the customer relationship, you'll partner cross\-collaboratively to ensure successful delivery. Your role spans from understanding domain\-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent\-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform\*\*, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges.
 



  





 This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands\-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross\-functional collaboration. You'll act as the connective tissue between pre\-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams, bringing our AI capabilities to life for real\-world business impact.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* Customer\-facing: 80% working directly with customers
* Design \& Deploy AI Agents: Build, configure, and launch intelligent agents using the DevRev platform to solve real customer problems.
* Integrate Systems: Connect AI agents with external platforms (e.g., CRMs, APIs, databases) for seamless workflow automation.
* Optimize Performance: Tune prompts, logic, and agent configurations for accuracy, reliability, and scalability.
* Own Requirements: Partner with customers to deeply understand their needs and translate them into technical agent specifications.
* Prototype \& Iterate: Lead live demos, build rapid proof\-of\-concepts, and refine solutions through customer feedback.
* Lead Execution: Define project plans, align internal teams, and ensure timely delivery of deployments.
* Advise Customers: Act as a trusted technical advisor on AI agent architecture, performance, and long\-term scalability.



  





**What You Bring:** 



* Experience: 7\+ years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or technical consulting. Customer\-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms, (Nice to have: Go).
* Applied AI Knowledge: Large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Cloud \& DevOps: Hands\-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* System Integration: Comfortable integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and event/data pipelines.
* Data\-Driven Mindset: Use A/B testing, telemetry, and metrics to guide decisions and drive improvements.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders.
* Customer Empathy: A bias for action and a relentless focus on solving problems for customers.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in AI/architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, SAFe) are a plus.
* **Travel: This role requires approximately 80% travel, primarily for customer implementations, technical workshops and on\-site engagements.**



  





 As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
