title: AI Platform Tech Lead
description:
**Build your future with Sovos.**
 If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever\-changing regulatory landscape.
   

  

 At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.
   

  

 Our purpose\-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

*Lead how Sovos designs, operates, and scales AI across the business*
 Sovos is transforming how the world's businesses navigate an increasingly complex tax and regulatory landscape, while simultaneously reinventing how we build software. Within the Office of the CTO, the Sovos Platform organization is growing our AI Platform team \- responsible for LLMOps foundation, tooling, and architectural patterns that let every engineering team at Sovos build and ship with AI responsibly and effectively.
   

  

 We're looking for an AI Tech Lead to guide that foundation from the inside. You will sit at the intersection of platform engineering, architecture, and enablement \- leading the technical decisions that shape our LLMOps practice, guiding the engineers who build it, and acting as the connective tissue between the AI Platform team and every other team at Sovos learning to build with these tools. This is a highly visible role with a direct line to how AI gets used across the company.
   

  

**The Work You'll Do**
***Guiding LLMOps Strategy and Team Execution***
* You'll provide the technical leadership that keeps our LLMOps practice coherent as it scales \- guiding the AI Platform team's day\-to\-day decisions and making sure the practice holds together as new models, tools, and use cases arrive.
* Guide and support the AI Platform team on LLMOps decisions: model selection, evaluation strategy, prompt and context management, observability, and cost governance
* Set technical direction for how Sovos deploys, monitors, and continuously improves LLM\-based and agentic systems in production
* Establish standards and guardrails for prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI usage across teams
* Own the health of our LLMOps tooling and observability stack, and make the build\-vs\-buy calls as the landscape evolves


***Shaping Design and Architecture Decisions***
* You'll bring architectural rigor to how AI capabilities get built into the Sovos Platform, ensuring new AI features are designed to scale and integrate cleanly with Core Platform, Sovos Identity, and our broader compliance infrastructure.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to design AI\-enabled features and agentic services, from prototype through production
* Review and advise on technical designs across teams building on the AI Platform, flagging risk and identifying reuse opportunities early
* Help define the architectural patterns and reference implementations (skills, MCP tools, agent frameworks) other teams build from
* Balance rapid experimentation with the long\-term architectural integrity of the platform


***Partnering with Teams Across Sovos***
* Platform capabilities only create value once teams can actually use them. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for teams learning to adopt our LLMOps and AI toolsets, translating platform capability into practical, everyday workflows.
* Act as a trusted advisor to product and engineering teams adopting AI coding assistants, agentic frameworks, and platform APIs
* Run workshops, office hours, and hands\-on sessions that teach teams how to use platform\-level LLM Ops and AI tooling effectively
* Translate platform capabilities into clear guidance, playbooks, and Skills that make the right way the easy way
* Communicate AI Platform direction and adoption progress to engineering leadership, product stakeholders, and the broader organization


***Leading and Growing the Team***
* You'll provide day\-to\-day guidance and technical leadership to the engineers building the AI Platform, raising the bar on quality while keeping the team moving fast.
* Guide and mentor AI Platform engineers, providing technical direction, code and design review, and career development
* Foster a culture of rapid experimentation, rigorous evaluation, and continuous learning
* Remove blockers so the team can ship reliable AI capabilities quickly
* Partner with the Chief Architect on team structure, hiring, and roadmap prioritization


**What We Need From You**
* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful hands\-on time building and operating LLM\-based or agentic AI systems in production
* Deep familiarity with LLMOps practice: evaluation frameworks, observability and monitoring, prompt engineering, cost and performance optimization
* Experience guiding or leading engineers, whether as a formal manager, tech lead, or through mentorship and technical authority
* Strong architectural instincts \- comfortable making and defending design decisions that other teams will build on
* Hands\-on experience with modern AI coding assistants and agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar)
* Technical depth across full\-stack development; familiarity with JavaScript/React and Java or .NET service\-oriented systems is a strong plus
* Excellent communication skills \- able to explain AI platform concepts clearly to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders
* A track record of enabling other teams: through documentation, shared tooling, workshops, or hands\-on pairing


**What Sets You Apart**
* Experience standing up or scaling an LLMOps practice from the ground up
* A genuine enthusiasm for teaching \- you'd rather show ten teams how to fish than build it for them once
* Comfort operating at the boundary of ambiguity, translating a fast\-moving AI landscape into concrete, adoptable guidance
* Experience balancing platform architecture rigor with the speed a hands\-on tech lead role demands


**What Sovos Offers You**
* Flexibility: 3 days per week in our Navi Mumbai (Airoli) office, with remote options for the rest.
* International exposure with a global organization.
* Bi\-Weekly Meeting\-Free Days.
* Mentoring programs and career development opportunities.
* Globally recognized training and development programs.
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage.
* A collaborative environment with modern tools and technologies.


**Our Recruitment Process**
* CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) \& EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
* Automated Video Interview
* Department Interview with Hiring Manager and/or team
* Final Interview


**Company Background**
 Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance, and trust solutions, enabling businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with confidence. With more than 100,000 customers in 100\+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – Sovos processes over three billion transactions annually across 19,000 tax jurisdictions.
   

  

 Founded in 1979, Sovos operates across the Americas and Europe, backed by Hg and TA Associates. Learn more at sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
The role
 



 You will work across mobile, web, backend and cloud infrastructure. This is not a narrow ticket\-execution role: you will understand the user problem, shape requirements, make sound architectural decisions and ship complete features into production in close collaboration with the founder, product, design, AI/video and business teams.
 



 What you will own
 



 Product engineering
 


* Translate product ideas and business requirements into clear technical plans, milestones and production\-ready features.
* Own features end to end: discovery, technical design, implementation, testing, release, monitoring and iteration.
* Balance speed with maintainability, security, scalability and a high\-quality user experience.
* Contribute product judgment—not only code—by identifying edge cases, simplifying flows and recommending better solutions.



  





**FULL STACK DEVELOPER** 




  





**Mobile and web experiences** 



* Build and maintain the consumer mobile application in Flutter, including camera access, video capture and upload, challenge participation, profiles, rewards, notifications and leaderboards.
* Develop responsive web applications and dashboards using React/Next.js for enterprise users, administrators, creators and brand partners.
* Turn designs into polished, intuitive interfaces with strong attention to layout, motion, responsiveness, accessibility and consistency.
* Improve application performance across device types, browsers, network conditions and large media files.



  





**Backend, data and platform architecture** 



* Design and develop secure, well\-structured services and APIs using Node.js/TypeScript; experience with NestJS is preferred.
* Build data models and high\-performance workflows using PostgreSQL, an ORM such as Prisma, Redis and background job queues.
* Implement authentication, role\-based access, permissions, auditability, webhooks and third\-party integrations.
* Support real\-time and high\-engagement features such as scoring updates, leaderboards, notifications, moderation and campaign analytics.
* Design for multi\-tenant enterprise use, data isolation, reliability and increasing volumes of users, campaigns and video assets.



  





**AI and video workflows** 



* Integrate AI services for video scoring and analysis, avatar generation, voice, language, personalisation and content generation.
* Build resilient video ingestion, validation, storage, transcoding, rendering and delivery workflows using object storage, FFmpeg or related media services.
* Create asynchronous processing pipelines with queues, retries, progress states, fallbacks and cost\-aware API usage.
* Help improve trust and safety through moderation, fraud detection, duplicate or manipulated\-content checks and clear human\-review paths.



  










**Engineering quality and operations** 



* Set up and improve automated testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, error tracking, logging and production alerts.
* Deploy and operate services on a major cloud platform using containers and well\-managed environments.
* Diagnose production issues quickly and improve performance, resilience, security and developer efficiency over time.
* Maintain clear technical documentation and communicate progress, trade\-offs and risks to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.



  





 What we are looking for:
 



  




* 3–6 years of hands\-on experience building and shipping full\-stack products.
* **Strong Flutter and Dart capability** 
 for production mobile applications.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, React or Next.js, Node.js and modern API development.
* Solid experience with PostgreSQL, data modelling, caching, queues and performance optimisation.
* Experience integrating third\-party APIs, SDKs, cloud storage and external services reliably.
* Comfort with Docker, Git, CI/CD and at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
* A strong grasp of application security, authentication, permissions, privacy and responsible handling of user and enterprise data.
* **Product\-management ability:** 
 you can break down ambiguous requirements, prioritise, estimate and drive work to completion.
* **Excellent communication skills:** 
 you can explain decisions clearly, surface risks early and collaborate constructively.
* **A strong aesthetic sense** 
 and genuine care for interaction quality, visual polish and the details users notice.
* High ownership, curiosity and comfort working in an entrepreneurial environment where priorities can evolve quickly.



  





 Good to have:
 



  




* Experience with media\-heavy applications, video processing, streaming, transcoding or rendering pipelines.
* Experience with AI/ML APIs, multimodal models, recommendation or scoring systems, or human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation.
* Experience building gamification, social, creator, rewards, leaderboard or high\-concurrency consumer features.
* Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS, enterprise integrations, analytics dashboards and role\-based administration.
* Familiarity with WebSockets, event\-driven architecture, serverless services, content moderation or app\-store releases.



  





 How success will be measured
 


* Features move from concept to production with clear scope, sound engineering and predictable follow\-through.
* The mobile and web experiences feel fast, intuitive and visually refined.
* Video and AI workflows remain reliable despite large files, asynchronous processing and third\-party dependencies.
* The platforms become easier to operate, monitor, secure and scale with every release.
* Technical decisions and risks are documented and communicated before they become blockers.

**Qualifications**
* Bachelors or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* 9–12 years of software engineering experience, preferably within the financial services industry, with at least 4 years leading high\-performing Full Stack development teams.

title: AI Full-Stack Developer
description:
What Sphere does
 
 We build automation for companies that still run on spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads, and an ERP nobody enjoys using. Workflow automation, AI agent systems, and ERP integrations for small and mid\-sized businesses across manufacturing, retail, D2C and services.
 



 We're a small team. That's the point: you'll hear about a client's problem on Monday and see something you built running inside their business by Friday.
 


 What you'd actually do
 
 You'll start inside Sphere rather than in front of clients. Internal tooling, lead generation pipelines, and the automations that run our own business, all built under guidance.
 



 Week one, realistically: an n8n pipeline that pulls prospect data from a few sources, enriches it, scores it, and drops a clean shortlist somewhere the team already works. Then you find out it breaks on half the inputs, and you fix that too.
 



 Client\-facing work during the internship is mostly maintenance. Keeping deployed systems running, and learning how they actually work end to end.
 



 At full\-time, the scope opens up. You'll write full backends and own client work directly.
 


 What we're looking for
 * You code with AI assistance and can tell when the output is wrong
* You're fast. A working first draft beats a perfect one that lands next week
* You're curious about industries that aren't tech, and how businesses actually run
* You want to be client\-facing eventually, even if you're not ready for it today


 Nice to have
 * Hands\-on with n8n, Make, or Zapier
* Things you've actually built and shipped. Side projects, freelance work, anything with real users
* Any exposure to ERPs, accounting systems, or business operations


 Who this isn't for
 * Someone who wants a well\-defined ticket queue and clear specs
* Someone who wants to train models and publish papers. This is applied engineering
* Someone who'd rather not talk to clients, ever


 How we hire
 1. Apply. The form takes ten minutes.
2. A short open\-ended project. A few hours. Deliberately under\-specified, because we want to see how you scope something, not whether you can follow instructions.
3. Two conversations. 15 to 60 minutes each, online or at our office. You'll walk through what you built and we'll talk about how you think.
4. Offer.


 Terms
 
 Six months, with the full\-time offer reviewed at month three. This is a hire\-track internship, not a temporary role.
 



 Mumbai hybrid is the preference. Fully remote is open for candidates who are clearly exceptional.
 



 Final\-year students and recent graduates are welcome. One to two years of experience is a plus, not a requirement.
